item.title: Week 11: Steelers at Eagles
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: PIT -4.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model PHI 37% vs. market 34% | The game turns on whether Philadelphia can manufacture chunk plays, since its 6.2% explosive rate is the league's worst, while Pittsburgh's tacklers must keep the Eagles from breaking free in space. Jaylen Warren gains 2.1 rushing yards over expected per carry, best in the league, and he runs into a Philadelphia run defense ranked 16th. Our model puts Pittsburgh at 63% and the market at 66%, with the rushing matchup driving our number.
